order.src:
; Der Gaertner: lebt von Brunnenwasser mit Filter und von seinem Beet. Kaempft nie, flieht immer.
.name "Gardener"
.author "hexplanet"
.motive "Grow food, drink clean water, avoid everyone."
.goal "Outlast the fighters by never needing to fight."
.behavior
main:   SENSE threat, r0
        JLT r0, 3, run
        SENSE thirst, r0
        JGT r0, 45, drink
        SENSE hunger, r0
        JGT r0, 50, eat
        SENSE filter, r0
        JZ r0, makef
        SENSE crop, r0
        JEQ r0, 2, harvest
        JZ r0, plant
        SENSE dirty, r0
        JLT r0, 3, getw
        FIND berry, r1
        JLT r1, 0, idle
        GO r1
        FORAGE
        JMP main
idle:   REST
        JMP main
run:    FLEE
        JMP main
drink:  SENSE water, r0
        JNZ r0, sip
        SENSE dirty, r0
        JZ r0, getw
        SENSE filter, r0
        JZ r0, sip
        FILTER
sip:    DRINK
        JMP main
getw:   FIND fresh, r1
        JLT r1, 0, idle
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        FILL
        FILL
        FILL
        JMP main
eat:    SENSE food, r0
        JZ r0, forage
        EAT
        JMP main
forage: FIND food, r1
        JLT r1, 0, idle
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        HARVEST
        FORAGE
        JMP main
makef:  SENSE sand, r0
        JLT r0, 2, dsand
        SENSE wood, r0
        JZ r0, dwood
        CRAFT filter
        JMP main
dsand:  FIND sand, r1
        JLT r1, 0, main
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 0, main
        DIG
        JMP main
dwood:  FIND tree, r1
        JLT r1, 0, main
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        CHOP
        JMP main
plant:  SENSE seeds, r0
        JZ r0, main
        SENSE dirty, r0
        JZ r0, getw
        FIND soil, r1
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 0, main
        PLANT
        JMP main
harvest: FIND crop, r1
        GO r1
        HARVEST
        JMP main

; Der Jaeger: schmiedet ein Messer und jagt den Schwaechsten. Lebt von der Beute.
.name "Hunter"
.author "hexplanet"
.motive "The weak feed the strong."
.goal "Forge a knife early, then hunt whoever has the fewest hit points."
.behavior
main:   SENSE thirst, r0
        JGT r0, 55, drink
        SENSE hunger, r0
        JGT r0, 60, eat
        SENSE knife, r0
        JZ r0, forge
        SENSE hp, r0
        JLT r0, 35, heal
hunt:   FIND weak, r1
        JLT r1, 0, roam
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, chase
        ATTACK r1
        JMP main
chase:  GO r1
        JMP main
roam:   RND r1, 6
        STEP r1
        JMP main
heal:   REST
        JMP main
drink:  SENSE water, r0
        JNZ r0, sip
        SENSE dirty, r0
        JNZ r0, sip
        FIND fresh, r1
        JLT r1, 0, hunt
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        FILL
        FILL
sip:    DRINK
        JMP main
eat:    SENSE food, r0
        JZ r0, getfood
        EAT
        JMP main
getfood: FIND berry, r1
        JLT r1, 0, hunt
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        FORAGE
        JMP main
forge:  SENSE stone, r0
        JZ r0, gstone
        SENSE wood, r0
        JZ r0, gwood
        CRAFT knife
        JMP main
gstone: FIND rock, r1
        JLT r1, 0, hunt
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        DIG
        JMP main
gwood:  FIND tree, r1
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        CHOP
        JMP main

; Die Salzsiederei: setzt eine Destille an die Kueste und lebt vom Meer. Faengt Fische.
.name "Saltworks"
.author "hexplanet"
.motive "The sea never runs dry."
.goal "Build a still by the coast, turn salt water into drinking water, fish for food."
.behavior
main:   SENSE threat, r0
        JLT r0, 2, defend
        SENSE thirst, r0
        JGT r0, 50, drink
        SENSE hunger, r0
        JGT r0, 50, eat
        SENSE still, r0
        JZ r0, build
        SENSE salt, r0
        JLT r0, 2, getsalt
        SENSE water, r0
        JLT r0, 3, boil
        FIND sea, r1
        GO r1
        FISH
        JMP main
defend: SENSE knife, r0
        JZ r0, flee
        FIND enemy, r1
        ATTACK r1
        JMP main
flee:   FLEE
        JMP main
boil:   FIND mystill, r1
        GO r1
        DESAL
        JMP main
getsalt: FIND sea, r1
        JLT r1, 0, main
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        FILL
        FILL
        JMP main
drink:  SENSE water, r0
        JNZ r0, sip
        SENSE dirty, r0
        JNZ r0, sip
        SENSE salt, r0
        JZ r0, getsalt
        SENSE still, r0
        JNZ r0, boil
        FIND fresh, r1
        GO r1
        FILL
sip:    DRINK
        JMP main
eat:    SENSE food, r0
        JZ r0, fish
        EAT
        JMP main
fish:   FIND water, r1
        GO r1
        FISH
        JMP main
build:  SENSE stone, r0
        JLT r0, 4, gstone
        SENSE wood, r0
        JLT r0, 3, gwood
        SENSE sand, r0
        JZ r0, gsand
        SENSE knife, r0
        JNZ r0, still
        CRAFT knife
still:  FIND sea, r1
        GO r1
        CRAFT still
        JMP main
gstone: FIND rock, r1
        GO r1
        DIG
        JMP main
gwood:  FIND tree, r1
        GO r1
        CHOP
        JMP main
gsand:  FIND sand, r1
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 0, main
        DIG
        JMP main

; Der Pluenderer: stiehlt aus fremden Taschen, zertruemmert Destillen und erntet fremde Beete.
.name "Raider"
.author "hexplanet"
.motive "Why grow what you can take?"
.goal "Live off other cores' gardens and stills, steal water and food, avoid fair fights."
.behavior
main:   SENSE thirst, r0
        JGT r0, 50, drink
        SENSE hunger, r0
        JGT r0, 55, eat
        SENSE hurt, r0
        JNZ r0, run
        FIND garden, r1
        JLT r1, 0, steal
        GO r1
        HARVEST
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        SABOTAGE r1
        JMP main
steal:  FIND enemy, r1
        JLT r1, 0, wander
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, sneak
        STEAL r1
        JMP main
sneak:  GO r1
        JMP main
wander: RND r1, 6
        STEP r1
        JMP main
run:    FLEE
        FLEE
        JMP main
drink:  SENSE water, r0
        JNZ r0, sip
        SENSE dirty, r0
        JNZ r0, sip
        FIND fresh, r1
        GO r1
        FILL
        FILL
sip:    DRINK
        JMP main
eat:    SENSE food, r0
        JZ r0, berry
        EAT
        JMP main
berry:  FIND food, r1
        JLT r1, 0, steal
        GO r1
        HARVEST
        FORAGE
        JMP main

; Der Einsiedler: zieht weit weg von allen, sammelt Beeren und trinkt aus dem Bach.
.name "Hermit"
.author "hexplanet"
.motive "Distance is the best armour."
.goal "Keep away from everyone, forage, drink from streams, rest a lot."
.behavior
main:   SENSE threat, r0
        JLT r0, 6, away
        SENSE thirst, r0
        JGT r0, 40, drink
        SENSE hunger, r0
        JGT r0, 45, eat
        SENSE food, r0
        JLT r0, 4, gather
        REST
        JMP main
away:   FLEE
        JMP main
drink:  SENSE dirty, r0
        JNZ r0, sip
        FIND fresh, r1
        JLT r1, 0, main
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        FILL
        FILL
        FILL
        FILL
sip:    DRINK
        JMP main
eat:    SENSE food, r0
        JZ r0, gather
        EAT
        JMP main
gather: FIND berry, r1
        JLT r1, 0, fish
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        FORAGE
        JMP main
fish:   FIND water, r1
        GO r1
        FISH
        JMP main

; Der Kriegsherr: baut Vorraete auf, dann greift er den Staerksten an, solange der noch schwach ist.
.name "Warlord"
.author "hexplanet"
.motive "Strike the leader before the leader strikes you."
.goal "Stock water and food, forge a knife, then hunt the strongest rival."
.behavior
main:   SENSE thirst, r0
        JGT r0, 45, drink
        SENSE hunger, r0
        JGT r0, 50, eat
        SENSE knife, r0
        JZ r0, forge
        SENSE dirty, r0
        JLT r0, 2, getw
        SENSE food, r0
        JLT r0, 2, getf
        SENSE alive, r0
        JLT r0, 3, duel
        FIND strong, r1
        JLT r1, 0, getf
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, chase
        ATTACK r1
        JMP main
duel:   FIND enemy, r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, chase
        ATTACK r1
        JMP main
chase:  GO r1
        JMP main
drink:  SENSE dirty, r0
        JZ r0, getw
        DRINK
        JMP main
getw:   FIND fresh, r1
        JLT r1, 0, main
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        FILL
        FILL
        FILL
        JMP main
eat:    SENSE food, r0
        JZ r0, getf
        EAT
        JMP main
getf:   FIND food, r1
        JLT r1, 0, fish
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        FORAGE
        JMP main
fish:   FIND water, r1
        GO r1
        FISH
        JMP main
forge:  SENSE stone, r0
        JZ r0, gs
        SENSE wood, r0
        JZ r0, gw
        CRAFT knife
        JMP main
gs:     FIND rock, r1
        GO r1
        DIG
        JMP main
gw:     FIND tree, r1
        GO r1
        CHOP
        JMP main
